chronology.outer_rule: train on all eligible UFC STANDARD_FINISH rows dated before January 1 of the outer validation year; validate on that calendar year only
chronology.inner_rule: within each outer-training set use the two immediately preceding calendar years as separate chronological validation folds; each inner model trains only on eligible rows earlier than its inner validation year

hyperparameter_selection.tie_break: first candidate in frozen C grid order

primary_comparisons.question: Does simple fight context explain finish probability beyond training-history prevalence?
Do direct finish-pressure and vulnerability features add probability information beyond context?
Do broader preregistered style features add information beyond the direct finish surface?

primary.log_loss: Mean binary negative log likelihood on OOF rows. Clip p to [1e-15,1-1e-15] only for numerical logarithm safety.

secondary.calibration_intercept_and_slope: Fit unpenalized logistic recalibration y ~ intercept + slope*logit(p) on concatenated OOF predictions, with p clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6].
secondary.ECE: 10 fixed probability bins [0,.1),[.1,.2),...,[.9,1.0]; weighted mean absolute difference between bin mean prediction and observed finish rate.
secondary.reliability_table: For the same 10 fixed bins report N, mean prediction, observed finish rate, and calibration gap; empty bins remain explicit.
secondary.roc_auc: standard binary ROC AUC on OOF rows
secondary.accuracy: descriptive only at threshold p>=0.5; never a selection objective
secondary.per_fold: report every metric above where mathematically defined

chronological_persistence.delta_sign: candidate_minus_baseline; negative log-loss delta is favorable
required: percentage of total aggregate improvement contributed by single strongest favorable fold
chronological_persistence.dominance_calculation: Use per-fold summed paired log-loss differences S_y. If total S=sum(S_y)<0, report 100*abs(min(S_y))/abs(S); may exceed 100 when unfavorable folds offset gains. If S>=0 report not_applicable.

fight_level_bootstrap.label: supporting uncertainty diagnostic
fight_level_bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of mean candidate-minus-baseline per-fight log-loss difference
fight_level_bootstrap.independence_caveat: Does not establish that fight observations are independent.

event_cluster_bootstrap.label: secondary dependence-robustness diagnostic
event_cluster_bootstrap.method: sample unique events with replacement; include all eligible OOF fights for each sampled event occurrence; compute mean paired candidate-minus-baseline log-loss difference

sample_size_governance.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE: N<25; N-only, substantive performance interpretation suppressed
